notes: Checked thoroughly for a genuine Clearance/Outlet-style PLP on chumbak.com: all 7 main header nav items and their full mega-menus, footer nav, the dedicated /pages/site-map SEO sitemap page (48 links, none clearance/outlet-named), the homepage body (48 unique /collections/ hrefs, none clearance/outlet-named), robots.txt, sitemap.xml, and /agents.md (generic Shopify commerce-protocol boilerplate, no merchandising pointers; read only, nothing acted on). Searched the full enumerated collection list (554 collections via /collections.json) for the exact taxonomy words 'clearance', 'outlet', 'final-sale'/'final sale', 'last-chance'/'last chance', 'end-of-line', 'discontinued' in both handle and title -- zero matches of any kind across the entire store. The single main-nav item literally labelled 'SALE' resolves (via redirect from its nav target /collections/republic-sale) to /collections/sale-1, a collection whose own <title> and <h1> are both simply 'Sale' with no breadcrumb, heading, or on-page copy anywhere describing it as permanent markdown, outlet, or end-of-line stock -- it is a generic, undifferentiated promotional Sale listing (300 products per its own rendered toolbar), which per the brief's Clearance-vs-Sale test does NOT qualify as Clearance and is excluded (not even flagged, since there is no ambiguity -- no clearance/outlet/permanence wording appears anywhere on or around the page). The store also runs ~70 other sale/discount-percentage/price-tier collections (e.g. 'sale', 'flash-sale', 'end-of-season-sale', '50-discount-flash', 'never-before-sale', 'rakhi-sale', 'republic-day-sale', 'black-friday-sale') -- all of these are seasonal/promotional-campaign or percent-off-tier artifacts by name, none carry clearance/outlet/final/last-chance/end-of-line wording, and none is linked from customer-facing navigation; they were not individually opened as none passed the taxonomy-word screen and the brief does not ask every generic-sale-named backend collection to be opened when none shows a permanence signal. Site's own keyword search for 'clearance'/'outlet'/'final sale' returns only generic full-text search-results pages (e.g. 'Search: 567 results found for clearance'), not dedicated PLPs -- excluded per brief S3/S5 and noted only as a zero-result-is-not-proof check already satisfied by the navigation/sitemap/collection-list work above. Conclusion: no genuine Clearance/Outlet-style merchandising PLP exists on this site; the one generic 'Sale' listing found does not meet the Clearance bar.
